brief.meaningEn: Appear so engaging in filmed performance that viewers’ attention is drawn to the performer.
brief.meaningZh: 演員在鏡頭前富有魅力和感染力，令觀眾目光集中。
brief.grammar: an actor lights up the screen; she lit up the screen.
brief.register: Positive entertainment review phrase; the screen itself need not be bright.
brief.boundaryZh: 指表演者的銀幕魅力，不是畫面曝光更亮，也不等於整部電影一定成功。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 light 解成照明操作；要指出演員如何吸引觀眾。
brief.outcomeZh: 能評價具體的銀幕表演與觀眾反應。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 17, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The young actor can light up the screen with one smile.

listening.en: The short film has a quiet opening, yet the newcomer’s lively expressions immediately light up the screen and draw viewers into the scene.
listening.zh: 短片開頭平靜，但新演員生動的表情隨即在銀幕上光彩奪目，令觀眾投入。

options.en: The newcomer’s engaging screen presence catches the viewers’ attention.
options.zh: 新演員富感染力的銀幕表現吸引觀眾。

options.en: Quick editing, rather than the newcomer’s performance, gives the opening its energy.
options.zh: 開場活力主要來自快速剪接，而非新演員的表演。

options.en: The supporting cast carries the scene while the newcomer has little effect on it.
options.zh: 場面主要靠配角帶動，新演員影響不大。

options.en: The script explains the plot clearly, but the newcomer does not draw attention.
options.zh: 劇本清楚交代情節，但新演員沒有特別吸引目光。

listening.explanationZh: 句子明言新演員生動的表情使觀眾投入，稱讚的是她的銀幕感染力，而非剪接或配角。

reply.promptEn: What did you think of the young actor in the school film?
reply.promptZh: （你覺得校園電影中的年輕演員表現如何？）

options.en: Her expressions made the awkward reunion scene feel warm.
options.zh: 她的表情令尷尬的重逢場面變得溫暖。

options.en: She lit up the screen whenever she appeared.
options.zh: 她每次出場都在銀幕上光彩奪目。

options.en: She held my attention even in the quieter scenes.
options.zh: 即使在較平靜的場面，她仍能抓住我的注意。

options.en: Her performance made me want to watch her next film.
options.zh: 她的演出令我想看她的下一部電影。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可稱讚她的演出；金句應用本課表達，描述她的銀幕魅力。

scene.promptZh: 演員在劇中只出現數分鐘，卻憑自然反應成為觀眾最記得的人。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She lights up the screen despite having only a brief role.
options.zh: 雖然戲份不多，她仍在銀幕上光彩奪目。

options.en: Her role is remembered mainly because it lasts longer than the others.
options.zh: 她的角色令人難忘，主要因為戲份比其他角色長。

options.en: She needed much longer screen time to be noticed.
options.zh: 她需要更長的戲份才會被留意。

scene.explanationZh: 短暫出場仍令人難忘，重點是演員的銀幕魅力。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個描述最不適合說演員 light up the screen？

options.en: Her smile makes a simple close-up unexpectedly engaging.
options.zh: 她的笑容使簡單特寫意外地吸引人。

options.en: The audience remembers her small role more than several larger ones.
options.zh: 觀眾對她的小角色比幾個大角色更有印象。

options.en: A technician makes the projected image brighter while the actor’s performance remains flat.
options.zh: 技術人員調高投影亮度，但演員表演仍平淡。

contrast.explanationZh: 調高投影亮度並不代表演員的銀幕表演有魅力。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我本以為那個小角色沒甚麼特別，結果每次她出場我都留意她。」哪句回應最貼切？

options.en: She seems to light up the screen, even without a leading role.
options.zh: 她看來即使不是主角也能在銀幕上光彩奪目。

options.en: Perhaps the editing gives her short scenes their impact, rather than her acting.
options.zh: 或許短場面的感染力來自剪接，而非她的演出。

options.en: Maybe the other actors make those scenes memorable regardless of what she does.
options.zh: 也許那些場面因其他演員而難忘，與她的表現無關。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友說每次她出場都會留意她，關鍵是這位演員本身的銀幕魅力，並非剪接或其他演員。

speaking.en: In the final scene, the actor lights up the screen with a small, hopeful smile.
speaking.zh: 在最後一幕，演員以一個細微而充滿希望的笑容，在銀幕上光彩奪目。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出她如何吸引觀眾。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生製作一段短片，一位平日害羞的同學在鏡頭前演出，憑真誠的笑容和自然反應吸引全班觀眾。用一至兩句英文評價她的銀幕表現。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出同學在鏡頭前的具體表現及觀眾反應；light up the screen 應指演出魅力。

examples.en: Her sincere smile and natural reactions light up the screen, and our classmates follow her every move.
examples.zh: 她真誠的笑容和自然反應令她在銀幕上光彩奪目，全班同學都留意她的一舉一動。

examples.en: Although she is usually shy, she lights up the screen in our short film and draws the whole class into the scene.
examples.zh: 雖然她平時害羞，但她在我們的短片中光彩奪目，令全班投入那一幕。

takeaways.en: The supporting actor lit up the screen in a brief scene at the station.
takeaways.zh: 配角在車站的短暫場面中光彩奪目。

takeaways.en: An expressive face can light up the screen without a long speech.
takeaways.zh: 即使沒有長篇對白，富表情的面孔也能在銀幕上發光。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Seem to others to have a particular quality, regardless of the speaker’s intention.
brief.meaningZh: 言行在別人眼中呈現某種特質；這個印象不一定與本人原意相同。
brief.grammar: come across as impatient; came across as helpful.
brief.register: Neutral everyday phrase, used for impressions in conversation or writing.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課 come across as 指言行給別人的印象；既有第 120 課 come across 指偶然遇見或發現，兩者須按完整結構與語義分開判斷，不能只用部分字串歸類。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 come across 誤解為偶然找到東西；要補上 as 及所形成的印象。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分說話者意圖和別人實際感受到的語氣。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 17, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A short reply may come across as rude.

listening.en: Mina meant to be efficient, but her one-word email replies came across as impatient to the new volunteers.
listening.zh: 美娜原意是提高效率，但她只用一個字回覆電郵，令新義工覺得她不耐煩。
listening.promptZh: came across as impatient 強調甚麼？

options.en: Her replies gave others an impatient impression, though she may not have intended it.
options.zh: 她的回覆令別人覺得她不耐煩，儘管那未必是她的原意。

options.en: She had told the volunteers she was deliberately angry with them.
options.zh: 她告訴義工自己故意對他們生氣。

options.en: Her replies were delayed, rather than short.
options.zh: 她回覆得遲，而非回覆得短。

options.en: The volunteers found her message difficult to locate.
options.zh: 義工很難找到她的訊息。

listening.explanationZh: 原意是有效率，但他人感受到的是不耐煩；句子聚焦表現給人的印象。

reply.promptEn: How might our brief announcement sound to people who have not met us?
reply.promptZh: （這段簡短公告會令未見過我們的人覺得我們怎樣？）

options.en: The wording may seem rather formal to newcomers.
options.zh: 措辭對新來者而言可能太正式。

options.en: Some readers may think we sound rushed.
options.zh: 部分讀者可能覺得我們語氣匆忙。

options.en: It could come across as unfriendly without a greeting.
options.zh: 若沒有問候語，它可能給人不友善的印象。

options.en: It might seem impersonal to readers who do not know us.
options.zh: 未認識我們的讀者可能覺得它缺少人情味。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都直接描述現有公告給陌生讀者的可能印象；金句用 come across as 說明沒問候語可能顯得不友善。

scene.promptZh: 組長本想節省時間，卻在新人提問時只說「自己看通知」。新人覺得他冷淡。哪句最貼切？

options.en: His reply came across as dismissive even though he meant to save time.
options.zh: 他的回覆給人敷衍的印象，雖然他原意只是節省時間。

options.en: His reply proved that he disliked every new member.
options.zh: 他的回覆證明他討厭每一位新成員。

options.en: His reply was warm, and newcomers clearly felt reassured.
options.zh: 他的回覆親切，新人明顯感到安心。

scene.explanationZh: 組長原意和新人觀感不同；come across as 正好描述後者。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不適合用 come across as 來描述「給人某種印象」？

options.en: A hurried message seems curt to its readers.
options.zh: 匆忙的訊息令讀者覺得語氣生硬。

options.en: A patient explanation seems reassuring to a visitor.
options.zh: 耐心的解釋令訪客感到安心。

options.en: A student finds a missing book behind the shelf.
options.zh: 學生在書架後找到一本遺失的書。

contrast.explanationZh: 找到物件屬 come across 的另一種用法，並非 come across as 後接印象。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我只是想把提醒寫得簡潔，卻有人說我很嚴厲。」哪句回應最貼切？

options.en: Your message may have come across as harsh; a greeting could soften its tone.
options.zh: 你的訊息或許給人嚴厲的印象；加上問候語或能令語氣柔和。

options.en: Their reaction shows you definitely intended to be harsh.
options.zh: 他們的反應證明你一定是故意嚴厲。

options.en: A shorter message would necessarily sound warmer.
options.zh: 把訊息寫得更短就一定更溫暖。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認別人的觀感，同時沒有把它誤作說話者的意圖。

speaking.en: His careful questions came across as thoughtful, not critical, during the interview.
speaking.zh: 他在訪問中細心提問，給人深思熟慮而非挑剔的印象。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出訪問者形成的印象。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替義工團寫邀請電郵，原想寫得簡潔，但初稿缺乏問候語，令新成員覺得冷淡。用一至兩句英文描述觀感及可作的修改。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出原意、讀者感受到的冷淡印象，以及可改善語氣的具體改動；不要斷言作者真心冷淡。

examples.en: I meant to keep the invitation brief, but it may come across as cold without a greeting, so I will add a warmer opening.
examples.zh: 我原本想把邀請寫得簡潔，但沒有問候語可能令人覺得冷淡，因此我會加上較溫暖的開頭。

examples.en: The draft came across as unfriendly to new volunteers despite my good intentions; I will thank them at the start.
examples.zh: 雖然我原意是好的，初稿仍令新義工覺得不友善；我會在開頭感謝他們。

takeaways.en: Her comment came across as supportive because she offered a useful suggestion.
takeaways.zh: 她提出實用建議，因此評論給人支持的感覺。

takeaways.en: A direct question can come across as rude if the tone is too sharp.
takeaways.zh: 如果語氣太尖銳，直接提問可能給人粗魯的印象。

brief.meaningEn: A celebrity’s ability to attract an audience or public attention.
brief.meaningZh: 知名藝人的名氣與魅力能吸引觀眾、媒體或支持者的力量。
brief.grammar: use star power to draw an audience; star power alone may not sustain a film.
brief.register: Entertainment and media phrase; it measures draw, not artistic merit.
brief.boundaryZh: 強調明星帶來的關注或票房，不保證作品本身質素高，也不指天上的星星。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把名氣直接等同好表演；若觀眾主要為故事而來，則不必歸功於 star power。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分名人吸引力和作品內容的價值。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 17, row 13; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The film relied on star power to fill cinemas.

listening.en: The film’s story received mixed reviews, but tickets sold quickly after the well-known singer joined the cast. The producer credited her star power.
listening.zh: 電影故事評價不一，但知名歌手加入演員陣容後，門票迅速售出。製片人把這歸功於她的明星號召力。
listening.promptZh: 製片人認為甚麼促使門票售出？

options.en: The singer’s fame attracted people who wanted to see her.
options.zh: 歌手的知名度吸引想看她的觀眾。

options.en: Reviewers had unanimously praised the film’s story.
options.zh: 評論者一致讚賞電影故事。

options.en: The cinema reduced all ticket prices after she joined.
options.zh: 她加入後，戲院調低所有票價。

options.en: The singer wrote the entire screenplay herself.
options.zh: 歌手親自寫了整個劇本。

listening.explanationZh: 關鍵是知名歌手加入後門票迅速售出，並非故事獲一致好評。

reply.promptEn: Why did the small charity concert sell out soon after announcing its guest performer?
reply.promptZh: （小型慈善音樂會宣布嘉賓後為何很快售罄？）

options.en: Many of the performer’s fans bought tickets to see her.
options.zh: 很多嘉賓的歌迷買票看她。

options.en: Her star power brought the concert to a much wider audience.
options.zh: 她的明星號召力令音樂會吸引更多觀眾。

options.en: The announcement gave the concert wider publicity.
options.zh: 嘉賓公布後，音樂會得到更多宣傳。

options.en: People who followed her work decided to support the event.
options.zh: 關注她作品的人決定支持活動。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理解釋售罄；金句以 star power 概括嘉賓名氣帶來的觀眾。

scene.promptZh: 地方劇團邀請知名演員參與新劇，預售隨即大增。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The actor’s star power helped bring new audiences to the production.
options.zh: 該演員的明星號召力幫助劇作吸引新觀眾。

options.en: The script must have attracted the extra buyers through strong reviews rather than the new actor.
options.zh: 增加的購票者一定是受劇本好評吸引，而不是因為新加入的演員。

options.en: The actor’s arrival may help publicity, but it cannot affect advance ticket sales.
options.zh: 演員加入或許有助宣傳，卻不會影響預售票房。

scene.explanationZh: 知名演員加入後預售立即增加，最直接的解釋是名氣帶來觀眾；題目沒有提供劇本好評證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合把入場人數歸因於 star power？

options.en: A famous actor’s name on the poster brings in many fans.
options.zh: 著名演員的名字印在海報上，吸引許多影迷。

options.en: A well-known singer’s surprise appearance draws media attention.
options.zh: 知名歌手的驚喜亮相吸引傳媒關注。

options.en: An unknown cast fills a small hall after excellent reviews of the script.
options.zh: 不知名的演員陣容憑劇本的好評令小劇院滿座。

contrast.explanationZh: 入場原因是劇本好評，並非名人的號召力。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我因主角是著名歌手而買票，但看完覺得劇情一般。」哪句回應最貼切？

options.en: Her star power may have drawn you in, but that alone does not guarantee a strong story.
options.zh: 她的明星號召力可能吸引你入場，但單靠名氣不能保證故事精彩。

options.en: Perhaps you bought the ticket for the story as much as for the singer.
options.zh: 也許你買票既為故事，也為那位歌手。

options.en: Her name probably filled seats, so the story may have been stronger than you thought.
options.zh: 她的名字大概令座位坐滿，所以劇情可能比你所想更精彩。

dialogue.explanationZh: 朋友明言因著名歌手買票，卻覺得劇情一般；金句把明星吸引力與故事質素分開。

speaking.en: The concert sold out on star power, but the arrangements still had to satisfy the audience.
speaking.zh: 音樂會憑明星號召力售罄，但編曲仍須令觀眾滿意。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出明星號召力能做到甚麼、不能保證甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區文化節邀請一位知名演員擔任朗讀嘉賓，宣傳後預約增加；你仍希望節目內容本身有質素。用一至兩句英文評價。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出知名演員如何吸引預約，以及節目內容仍須有質素；不要把名氣說成質素的保證。

examples.en: The actor’s star power brought more bookings to the community festival, but the readings still need strong material.
examples.zh: 演員的明星號召力令社區文化節獲得更多預約，但朗讀內容仍須扎實。

examples.en: Star power helped publicise the reading event after the actor joined, yet the programme still needs strong readings to reward its audience.
examples.zh: 演員加入後，明星號召力幫助宣傳朗讀活動，但節目仍需優質朗讀，令觀眾覺得值得。

takeaways.en: Star power filled the opening night, though critics still judged the play on its writing.
takeaways.zh: 明星號召力令首演滿座，但評論者仍按劇本評價作品。

takeaways.en: The campaign borrowed a singer’s star power to draw attention to the charity.
takeaways.zh: 這項活動借助歌手的明星號召力，吸引人關注慈善機構。

brief.meaningEn: Appeal to or connect people from different age generations.
brief.meaningZh: 讓不同世代的人都能欣賞、參與或產生連繫。
brief.grammar: music can cross generational lines; a story crossed generational lines.
brief.register: Figurative phrase about age groups, not literal boundary lines.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有不同世代之間的共同吸引力；不要求每個年齡層的喜好完全相同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把同齡人之間的流行誤說成跨世代，也不要把 lines 解成實體線條。
brief.outcomeZh: 能舉出兩代人如何透過同一作品產生交流。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 18, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The song managed to cross generational lines.

listening.en: At the festival, teenagers sang the chorus while their grandparents shared memories of hearing the song years earlier. The tune still crosses generational lines.
listening.zh: 節慶上，青少年唱着副歌，祖父母則分享多年前聽這首歌的回憶。這首曲子至今仍能跨越世代界線。
listening.promptZh: 這首歌如何跨越世代界線？

options.en: It gives younger and older listeners different ways to enjoy the same song.
options.zh: 年輕與年長聽眾都能以不同方式欣賞同一首歌。

options.en: It is known only to people who heard it when it was first released.
options.zh: 只有初次發行時聽過它的人才認識這首歌。

options.en: It was written to teach teenagers about music theory.
options.zh: 這首歌是為教青少年樂理而寫的。

options.en: All the listeners remember exactly the same event from the song.
options.zh: 所有聽眾從歌曲想起完全相同的事件。

listening.explanationZh: 青少年唱歌、祖父母回憶過去，同一曲子吸引不同世代，方式可以不同。

reply.promptEn: Why did the community choose this story for both the youth club and the seniors’ group?
reply.promptZh: （社區為何選這故事給青年會及長者小組一起分享？）

options.en: Young readers enjoy its humour, while older readers recognise its family themes.
options.zh: 年輕讀者欣賞幽默，年長讀者理解家庭主題。

options.en: It gives both groups something to discuss together.
options.zh: 它讓兩個小組有共同話題。

options.en: Its characters remind people of relationships at different ages.
options.zh: 人物令不同年齡的讀者想起自己的人際關係。

options.en: It crosses generational lines by engaging readers of different ages.
options.zh: 它吸引不同年齡的讀者，跨越世代界線。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋了共同選書；金句以 cross generational lines 概括跨年齡吸引力。

scene.promptZh: 一齣戲同時令中學生和他們的父母發笑，散場後兩代人還一起談論角色。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The play crossed generational lines and gave families a shared subject.
options.zh: 這齣戲跨越世代界線，給家庭一個共同話題。

options.en: Parents and teenagers laughed at different jokes, so the play gave them no shared experience.
options.zh: 家長與中學生笑的是不同笑話，所以這齣戲沒有帶來共同經歷。

options.en: Both age groups attended the theatre, but each followed a separate programme.
options.zh: 兩個年齡層都到過劇院，但各自參加不同節目。

scene.explanationZh: 中學生與家長都欣賞同一齣戲，散場後還一起討論角色；共同作品跨越世代界線，欣賞角度不必完全一樣。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說一個節目 crosses generational lines？

options.en: Parents and children enjoy its different layers of humour.
options.zh: 家長和孩子欣賞它不同層次的幽默。

options.en: Teenagers and grandparents both attend and discuss it afterwards.
options.zh: 青少年與祖父母都來參與，之後一起討論。

options.en: The entire audience belongs to the same school year, with no evidence of older viewers.
options.zh: 全部觀眾都來自同一年級，沒有年長觀眾的證據。

contrast.explanationZh: 只有同一年級參與，尚看不到跨越不同世代的吸引力。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這首舊歌原本是我媽媽喜歡的，現在我和同學也常唱，還會問她當年的故事。」哪句回應最貼切？

options.en: It crosses generational lines because it connects your classmates with your mother’s memories.
options.zh: 它跨越世代界線，把同學與你媽媽的回憶連起來。

options.en: The song may be familiar to your mother, while your classmates only know a brief sample.
options.zh: 你媽媽或許熟悉整首歌，而同學只認識一小段取樣。

options.en: You may sing the same chorus, but perhaps it gives you little to discuss together.
options.zh: 你們也許唱同一段副歌，但它未必帶來多少共同話題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 同學也常唱這首歌，還向媽媽問起往事；它促成兩代人的欣賞與交流，不必有完全相同的回憶。

speaking.en: The comedy crosses generational lines: children enjoy the jokes, and grandparents recognise the family stories.
speaking.zh: 這齣喜劇跨越世代界線：孩子欣賞笑話，祖父母則對家庭故事有共鳴。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出兩代人如何各自欣賞同一作品。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區圖書館舉辦故事夜，年輕人喜歡故事的冒險情節，祖父母則會分享與情節相似的童年回憶；兩代人之後一起聊天。用一至兩句英文介紹活動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出年輕人和祖父母各自欣賞甚麼，以及故事夜如何促成兩代人的交流。

examples.en: The story night crosses generational lines: young listeners enjoy the adventure, while grandparents share childhood memories afterwards.
examples.zh: 故事夜跨越世代界線：年輕聽眾欣賞冒險情節，祖父母則在活動後分享童年回憶。

examples.en: At the library, the adventure story crossed generational lines by giving young people and grandparents a reason to talk about their experiences.
examples.zh: 在圖書館，冒險故事為年輕人與祖父母帶來交流自身經歷的話題，跨越了世代界線。

takeaways.en: The board game crossed generational lines at our family gathering.
takeaways.zh: 這款桌上遊戲在家庭聚會上跨越世代界線。

takeaways.en: A shared story can cross generational lines even when each age group notices different details.
takeaways.zh: 即使各年齡層留意的細節不同，共同的故事仍能跨越世代界線。
